services.name: Dolphin Watching Cruise
services.desc: Dolphin Watching Nature Cruise and Eco Tour Observe Florida's wildlife up close in their natural habitat! 1.5 Hours About All tours are fully narrated, informative and fun. Boats are U.S. Coast Guard certified. For you convenience, refreshments, snacks and restrooms are available on board. Boats offer covered, comfortable seating along with open decks. Dolphins guaranteed; also pelicans, egrets, herons and occasionally manatee, osprey, and bald eagles. Touring upper Boca Ciega Bay from historic John's Pass Boardwalk! Travel through commercial fishing villages, past mangrove islands, and Nature Eco Tour

services.name: 3-Hour Shell Key Shelling Trip
services.desc: 3 Hours About Our 3hr Shell Key Shelling Trip is offered from our Main location inside Johns Pass and offers around one hour on the island exploring and shelling with around an hour ride down the back protected bay waters on a relaxing, safe, and fun trip. On the ride back to Johns Pass, we will cruise down our beautiful gulf beaches when weather allows, if its a little bumpy the ride back will also be in the back protected bay waters. We will often spot dolphins, seabirds, manatees and other wildlife on the ride out and 3 Hours

services.name: Sunset Cruise
services.desc: 1.5 Hours The sunset cruise leaves from Hubbard’s Marina inside historical Johns Pass. Our big blue dolphin watching nature cruise and eco tour boat also runs our sunset cruise with free beer and wine. This trip is a relaxing hour and a half cruise through the back protected bay waters then on the way home you get a front row seat for the sunset as the boat cruises along the beautiful gulf beaches showing you the beautiful beach hotels during the golden hour on your right with a gorgeous sunset to your left. During the sunset cruise we turn the music up a little louder and enjoy the Ready for a relaxed party atmosphere, FREE beer & wine + Awesome views of the sunset!

services.name: 5-Hour Half Day Fishing Trip
services.desc: 5 Hours including approximately 3 Hours of Fishing Time! Distance Cruising out 9 to 12 miles Depth 30 to 50 feet Catch Primarily Grey snapper (grunts), porgies, and black sea bass but if you use the live shrimp maybe some hogfish. Occasionally we catch mackerel and possible kingfish spring and fall Keep in mind this is the shortest trip closest to shore offered at Hubbard's Marina. We don't get monsters on this trip, but we catch a bunch of the smaller great eating fish and its fun for the whole family! Bait Cut squid provided on board at no extra charge. Live shrimp is available as 3 Hours Fishing · 1 Hour Out · 1 Hour Back

explain.meaning: A shorter trip, usually about four hours.

services.name: 10-Hour All Day Fishing Trip
services.desc: 10 Hours including approximately 6-7 Hours of Fishing Time! Distance Cruising out anywhere from 15-25 miles to fish around 60-100 feet at the captains discretion. We will do our best to put you on cooperative fish where we know they are biting best. We work hard to provide the most action and best opportunity to be as successful as possible. Catch May include Red grouper, gag grouper, mangrove snapper, grey snapper, porgies, black sea bass, hogfish, lane snapper, vermillion snapper, triggerfish, mackerel, and kingfish possible spring and fall. Keep in mind this is the shortest trip 6-7 Hours of Fishing Time!

services.name: 12-Hour Night Fishing Trip
services.desc: 12 Hours including 7-9 Full Hours of Fishing! Distance Cruising out 15 to 30 miles from shore. Depth The average depth is over 60-120 feet of water Catch Mangrove snapper, gag grouper, vermillion snapper, porgies, black sea bass, hogfish, yellowtail, kingfish in spring and fall. Bait Cut bait (sardines & squid) provided on board at no extra charge. $9 per dozen for pinfish, must be ordered more than 48hrs in advance. Great for grouper and big mangroves. 1-2 dozen recommended. $4 per dozen for live shrimp they are good for mangroves, hogfish, yellowtail, and other snapper (4 dozen 7-9 Hours of Fishing!

services.name: 12-Hour Extreme Fishing Trip aboard Flying HUB 2
services.desc: 12 Hours including 7-8 Full Hours of Fishing Time! Fishing Spots Please note: Fishing Spots are NOT assigned on this trip. Distance Cruising out 70 to 100 miles from shore to fish deep water ledges, wrecks, and potholes. Depth Depth: The average depth is over 120 feet. Catch Trophy sized Gag Grouper, Red Grouper, Scamp Grouper, Mangrove Snapper, Yellowtail Snapper, and Vermilion Snapper. Bait Cut bait (sardines & squid) provided on board at no extra charge. Live Pinfish can be purchased for $11 per dozen by advanced reservation from The Bait Shack. We suggest 1-2 dozen Pinfish per 7-8 Hours of Fishing! · Same Deep Waters as 39 Hour!

services.name: 39-Hour Overnight Fishing Trip
services.desc: Distance Cruising out up to 100 miles to the Florida Middle Grounds elbow, and surrounding areas , home to pristine coral ledges, hard bottom, potholes and natural springs that hold large numbers of hard fighting , quality game fish. Catch Includes Grouper, Amberjack, Mangrove, Mutton, Cubera, Hog and Red Snapper, King Mackerel, Dolphin, Wahoo, Blackfin Tuna and Cobia. Bait Cut bait (sardines & squid ) provided on board. Live Pinfish may be reserved up to 48hrs ahead of your trip for $11 per dozen.
